answers.before.prepNotes:
DRAWINGS: NJ Rouse 4ED.26.01 (existing, May 2026), .02 (location), .05 (proposed plans & elevations, Sept 2026), .06 & .07 (sections S1, S2, Oct 2026), .08 (specification). Designer's risk assessment 15 Oct 2026. Engineer: John Peck, calcs Rev A (20 Oct 2026) + 1st floor, 2nd floor and chimney support drawings.

SCOPE: hip-to-gable + rear dormer (5.625 m finished, hanging tiles, flat crown roof); loft = bedroom 5, bedroom 6 and en-suite; new stair over the existing; Velux 134×140 (bed 6) and 94×140 (over stairs). First floor re-planned: new stud walls, new en-suite, FD30 doors DF01–DF04, air con to all bedrooms. Ground floor: new shower room off the hall, partitions + FD30 doors DG03–DG05 to form a protected hall, remove living-room chimney breast with new beam + plates, sound-proofing to living & dining party wall. New boiler position to be agreed. Mains interlinked smoke/heat alarms, CO alarm.

STEEL (S355, intumescent paint or Glasroc F): ridge 152×152×44 UC (5.7 m) on 2 × 90 mm sq C24 posts; B1 152×152×23 UC; B2 203×203×52 UC; B3 203×203×46 UC; T5 152×152×23 UC; chimney support 152×152×23 UC + 10 mm plate (min 40 mm into party wall); L3 2 × 152×89 UB. Timber C24: floor 47×170 @ 400; flat roof 47×147 @ 400; trimmers 2 × 47×170 (T1–T3, T6–T9), T4 with 160×8 flitch plate, L1/L2 2 × 47×147. Bearing plates 250×100×15 and 350×100×20.

CHECK ON SITE: ridge height and party wall to party wall (engineer used 5.7 m ridge span); stair headroom 2.0 m (1.8 m at the edge); soil stack position for both en-suites and the shower room; where the boiler and the air con condensers go; chimney stack condition (stack stays, supported on the new steel); scaffold access on the side and rear; the neighbour at No. 6 (party wall notice – sound-proofing and steels into the party wall); fire board to the dormer cheek within 1 m of the boundary.

ASK THE ARCHITECT: gable finish – spec sheet says K-Rend render on the new gable, elevations say "all materials to match existing"; engineer's drawings show the postcode as RM11 1HX (architect: RM11 1XH).
